format: Markdown (with embedded code snippets in various languages)
description: This file documents the ConsoleMessage class in the Playwright API, describing its methods, properties, and usage examples across multiple programming languages. It serves as reference documentation for interacting with console messages within Playwright automated scripts.

classes.name: ConsoleMessage
classes.description: Represents a console message dispatched by a page in Playwright, with methods to access its arguments, location, text, type, associated page, and worker information.

methods.name: ConsoleMessage.args
methods.description: Returns an array of JSHandle objects representing the arguments passed to the console message.

methods.name: ConsoleMessage.location
methods.description: Returns the source location of the console message. In JS and Python, it returns an object with URL, lineNumber, and columnNumber; in C# and Java, it returns a formatted string with URL and position details.

methods.name: ConsoleMessage.page
methods.description: Returns the page object that generated this console message, if available.

methods.name: ConsoleMessage.text
methods.description: Returns the text content of the console message.

methods.name: ConsoleMessage.type
methods.description: Returns the type of the console message, such as 'log', 'error', 'warning', etc.

methods.name: ConsoleMessage.worker
methods.description: Returns the web worker or service worker that produced this console message, if any.
